real quick can u edit this text to jade. i want it funny but she needs to know im not dodging her lol

"ok so update from your resident vampire. im on nights sun thru thu 9pm to 7:30am now bc of overtime. i sleep 8:30am to 1:30pm so if i text back at 2 its not bc i forgot u, its bc im in my coffin 🧛 tonight is date night at pho ben thanh and i will try my best not to face plant in the broth. no promises. i will make it up to u i swear"

Here's a tightened version that keeps the jokes and makes the reassurance land:

"Update from your resident vampire 🧛 Overtime means I'm on nights Sunday through Thursday, 9 p.m. to 7:30 a.m. I sleep from 8:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m., so if I text back around 2, it's not that I forgot you, it's that I'm in my coffin. Tonight is date night at Phở Bến Thành and I will try very hard not to face-plant in the broth. No promises. I'm not dodging you, I just miss you in daylight. I'll make it up to you, I swear."

I added the "not dodging you" line so the honest part is clear under the humor. Want it shorter or goofier?
short version pls. and keep it less sappy

Short version:

"Resident vampire update 🧛 nights Sun-Thu, 9 p.m. to 7:30 a.m., and I sleep 8:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. So a 2 p.m. reply means I'm in my coffin, not ignoring you. Tonight's date night at Phở Bến Thành, and I'll try not to face-plant in the broth. Not dodging you, promise."

That keeps the jokes, drops the sappy line, and still gets the point across.
